primary: Actual LoRA trained on train12; fixed settings before holdout8 inference. Extra four-way comparison optional.
data_independence: No holdout use for prompt, model or hyperparameter adjustment. Any later changes are separate exploratory work.
quality_review: Source-grounded per-item explanation; flag AI-assisted review, not independent human gold. Pre-output reference labels preferred when available. Do not claim unbiased accuracy from post-output review.

manual_scales.source_support: 0 unsupported or wrong; 1 partial; 2 key claims supported
manual_scales.advice_actionability: 0 vague/unsafe; 1 partially usable; 2 specific and justified

reporting: Keep invalid/runtime-failed rows in denominator; first-pass and repaired JSON rates separate. Report n/8; no general accuracy claim from small sample.
